description: Live liquidation feed on Hyperliquid perps: recent liquidations with side, size, price and wallet, 1h/4h/24h totals with the long/short split, the largest event, and the markets with the most. Recovered from the fills of liquidation counterparties — a sample, not a census; the payload states its coverage. Filter by coins, side or minNotional; cap with limit (default 50). Result carries provenance.

minNotional.description: Only events at or above this USD notional.

since.description: ISO-8601 or epoch; only events after this time (window is 24h).
